lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to find and fix a mistake (a bug) in a script by watching what the character does.
A bug is a mistake in code.
It makes the character do the wrong thing.
Where does the character go wrong?
Change one block, then run it again.
Finding them is part of the fun!
This code has a bug: the bee goes the wrong way. Fix it so the bee reaches the flower star.
The down arrow should have been up. Bug squashed!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
